title: Linear flows: class-3 vertex-root pair failures are #P-hard when the dual slot has no layer-1 data
claim: p >= 5, r | p - 1, n graded with a grading-preserving C_r action, d | r, m = m_d (ideal of nonzero characters) of class at most 3. A linear-flow edge is a hard pair (alpha, beta) of m with slot types alpha, beta, gamma = alpha + beta such that m has no degree-1 component at a character of R(gamma) (LF) and vertex-private brackets vanish modulo gamma_3 outside R(gamma) and character 0 (B2'); the vertex-root condition (V3) may fail. If a linear-flow edge exists, counting |Hom(pi_1 S^3_(d/p)(K), G)| is #P-hard. Proof: on the layer-2 variety the vertex equations are a conserved flow (COPRIME-PAIRS-20261027-001F); the flow and the dual slot's constraints are linear in the dual slot's data, so each Fourier-dual edge weight is a non-negative count; the Brunnian rank witness and subdivision give EVAL(M) for a non-negative M of rank at least two. Together with Theorem 6 this decides all 16 census algebras whose only failing clean-edge condition is (V3); 8 are new, leaving 105 of 850 open.
failure_conditions: A census count other than 16 vertex-root algebras, 12 with linear-flow edges, and exactly the 8 listed new ones.

For free class 3 on (1, 1, 4) at d = 5, p = 11, slots (1, 1, 2): a solution where the endpoint flows are not exact negatives, a slot-1 configuration whose slot-2 solutions are not a linear subspace, a flow that is not additive in slot-2 data or nonzero at slot-2 data 0, a negative or non-real Fourier value, or off-diagonal flows vanishing on every sampled solution.
The control (free class 3 on (1, 2, 3), slots (1, 1, 2)) showing homogeneous-affine dependence on slot-2 data at every sampled point.
foundation_claim_scope: p >= 5, r | p - 1, graded nilpotent Lie algebras whose ideal m_d has class at most 3, grading-preserving C_r action; manifolds S^3_(d/p)(K). Cited: Theorems 4-6 and lemmas of COPRIME-PAIRS-20261027-001E and F, Lemma I, Bulatov-Grohe via Cai-Chen-Lu. Not covered: class 4, the 26 class-3 census algebras failing (B0) with (V3) or (B2') at a nonzero character. r counts the characters of the action, not Boolean variables. No P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: 16 open interacting census algebras fail only (V3); 12 have a linear-flow edge (no layer-1 data in the dual slot) and 8 of these are not decided by Theorem 6, listed; on free class 3 on (1,1,4) at d = 5, p = 11, exhaustively over the 11^4 private configurations at four vertex pairs: endpoint flows exact negatives, slot-2 solutions linear subspaces, flows additive in slot-2 data, Fourier values real and non-negative, off-diagonal flows nonzero; control (free class 3 on (1,2,3)) not homogeneous-affine in slot-2 data; no human or external review
